text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being right around curfew, the 
gym lights were still on. When I went to 
check...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All right, barbell routine done. Next up 
is 50 reps on the leg press...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...So what? I'm concentrating, so don't 
get in my way.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard is no good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...So what? I'm concentrating, so don't 
get in my way.
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard is no good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shuddup. Just leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heeey!! TAISHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. An even noisier one showed up.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry home and play funny-face 
rock-paper-scissors! We couldn't do it 
during lunch break!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Give it a rest! No matter how much you 
chase me, I'm not doing it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! All I have to do is win a game of 
tag?! All right, I'm definitely catching 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What gives you the right to 
just...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: On your mark! Get set!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, geez!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an astonishing burst of speed, Narita 
Taishin began pulling away from Winning 
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me. I know how to 
manage myself, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly noticed an open notebook 
sitting beneath the training equipment. 
...Written inside was a meticulously 
calculated training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
... Don't just go reading other people's 
notebooks without asking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It's not like I have a choice. I 
gotta do this much if I wanna win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Because I wasn't blessed, because I had 
nothing to start with, I gotta push and 
push and push myself to the limit――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh~! I'm so moved~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's you again, Ticket! Stop 
bawling your eyes out every single time, 
you're so loud!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff* I came to pick you up, but... I 
overheard what you said and *sob*...!! You 
did so good, you're amazing, 
Taishin~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But... but I'm just so worried you might 
be pushing yourself too haaard~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right... I hear you 
already. How'm I supposed to concentrate 
with all this racket?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll go back! Happy now?! ...Come 
on, stop crying, you're coming too!
